description: Review M3: put the classical and learned offset detectors on the same footing. Both are reduced to a decision field (the classical two-sample step statistic; the network's output) and read out by the same threshold+min-separation rule, so full precision-recall curves can be compared. Reports AP, F1 at each method's F1-optimal threshold, F1 at matched recall, and -- for the learned detector -- the cost of selecting its threshold on a held-out validation fold. The detector's training-seed distribution is estimated over 20 seeds.
